class.name: DdcCommandDef
class.description: Defines a run control transition command to be send for DCS

attribute.name: RunControlTransition
attribute.description: ID of TDAQ run control transition

attribute.name: DcsCommand
attribute.description: Name of PVSS datapoint representing DdcCommand

attribute.name: CommandParameters
attribute.description: String of command parameters of the type par1|par2|...|parN, where parI is the value of i-th parameter

attribute.name: Timeout
attribute.description: Timeout for the command execution. 0-value means "not defined". DDC is to apply the own default value.

relationship.name: TransitionCommands
relationship.description: Points to the run control transition commands to be send for DCS

relationship.name: DCSStationToConnect
relationship.description: DCS workstation running PVSS, which is to be connected

relationship.name: detectorAlarmDef
relationship.description: Points to the parameter to define DCS DP signalling detector alarm and it's polling time

attribute.name: ISServer
attribute.description: IS server name that is to be used for the data transfer

attribute.name: DaqDataReqServer
attribute.description: Is server name, which DAQa request for DCS data to be sent through

relationship.name: DcsExport
relationship.description: Points to a datapoint group to be exported by DCS to a certain IS server

relationship.name: DcsImport
relationship.description: Poinrs to a datapoint group to be exported by DCS to a certain IS server

relationship.name: DCSStationToConnect
relationship.description: DCS workstation running PVSS, which is to be connected

relationship.name: DcsAlarms
relationship.description: Points to the PVSS datapoint list, whose alarms are to be transferred. If the `AllAlarms` attribute is `true`, only the first DP name will be used.

relationship.name: DcsTextMessages
relationship.description: Points to PVSS variables (DPs) to be interpreted as DCS messages for DAQ of certain severity

relationship.name: DCSStationToConnect
relationship.description: DCS workstation running PVSS, which is to be connected

class.name: DdcTargetList
class.description: List of PVSS Datapoint names to be excanged

attribute.name: PvssDpeName
attribute.description: Name of a PVSS text datapoint to be interpreted (on change) as a DCS message for DAQ

attribute.name: MessageSeverity
attribute.description: Severity of DCS message for DAQ

attribute.name: SendWhileConnection
attribute.description: Says whether the message should be sent at the DAQ - DCS connection time

class.name: PvssDatapoint
class.description: PVSS datapoint to be observed by DDC-CT

class.name: PvssWorkstation
class.description: Class of workstations where a PVSS application to be connected by TDAQ is running
